name: Tags Input
description: A token entry field that turns typed text into removable chips.
usage:
const [tags, setTags] = useState(['design'])

<TagsInput label="Add label" value={tags} onChange={setTags} placeholder="Add a label…" />

anatomy.description: The container hosting the committed chips and the draft input.
Committed tokens with individual remove actions.
The inline text field where the next tag is typed.

dos: Commit on Enter and comma so both habits work.
Set max when the backend caps the list, and say so nearby.
Keep tokens to one or two words so chips stay scannable.
donts: Don't use it for a fixed option set; use MultiSelect.
Don't commit empty or whitespace-only tags.
Don't expect fuzzy dedupe; exact duplicates are ignored, so normalize case before commit if needed.

examples.title: Token entry
examples.description: Enter or comma commits a tag; Backspace on an empty draft removes the last one.

examples.title: Capped list
examples.description: max limits the reviewer list to three entries and the cap is stated nearby.

guidance.useWhen: A field collects an open-ended list of short tokens.
guidance.avoidWhen: Values come from a fixed set; use MultiSelect.
guidance.behavior: Enter or comma commits; duplicates are ignored and chips remove individually.
guidance.responsive: Chips wrap inside the field as the list grows.

keyboard.action: Commits the draft as a new tag.
Removes the last tag when the draft is empty.
Moves focus to the chip remove buttons and out of the field.

notes: Chips mirror the caller-owned value and each carries a labeled remove action.
Duplicate tags are ignored instead of being committed twice.
The max prop stops new entries once the cap is reached.

props.description: Accessible name for the text entry.
props.name: label

props.description: Maximum number of tags; further entries are ignored.
props.name: max

props.description: Called with the next tag list after every add or remove.
props.name: onChange

props.description: Placeholder shown in the text entry.
props.name: placeholder
